new_research_lead.title: How Do LLM Agents Actually Get the Flag? Trace-Level Provenance for Agentic Offensive Security Evaluation
verified_facts: The paper appears in arXiv cs.CR's Friday, August 28, 2026 recent-submissions batch.
The abstract says current CTF-agent evaluations can conflate demonstrated exploitation with direct flag exposure, memorized recall, external lookup, guessing, or unsupported claims.
The authors introduce CTF-ABACUS, a trace-based auditing framework intended to reconstruct runs as evidence-grounded solve profiles.
The framework is described as tracking where exploitation occurs, where a flag first appears, and whether the recovered flag is supported by demonstrated behavior.
new_research_lead.recommended_action: Evaluate the paper and any released implementation for license, reproducibility, dataset/benchmark assumptions, and whether its trace/provenance model can strengthen this repository's case evidence, solver-attempt, and autonomous-agent verification contracts. Do not import code or adopt benchmark claims until independently reviewed.
